part_i_reference.shared_measure_scope_and_literature_audi: Shared publication-scope audit distinguishes raw KE volume face masses from their probability-normalized versions, which are divided by total volume and are not a probability partition over faces. Ordinary recursive volume-IRFA yields one-sided Abel limits; the abstract cusp density e^(-t)(1+1/t) gives a logarithmic obstruction to meromorphic continuation and is not asserted to be KE volume. Joint polyhomogeneity with residual/angular L1 estimates remains an additional continuation assumption. The shared primary-source comparison with Chambert-Loir-Tschinkel separates prior residue-measure/Igusa leading-coefficient theory from this log-log depth and ordinary-L1 setting.
